description: Pull AI-generated cat pictures and short cat videos into a workflow: a random one to post, a batch to build a gallery from, or a search over the library by what the cat looks like. Every cat carries the prompt it was generated from, its theme and a link at any size from a 16px avatar to a 1024px picture, and both the random pick and any cat by id can be downloaded as a file to attach or upload. Ten themes, most of them seasonal, so a scheduled workflow can post a cat that suits the day: pumpkins in October, snow in December. No account or API key required.
